g.text: The challenge is a server event.
The first client frame is connect.
Device identity and pairing support broad Gateway access.
The v1 AsyncAPI documents a token query parameter.
The baseline route shown here extracts only conversation_id.
There is no connect protocol negotiation.
Campus target: independent internal Runtime connection
open separate TLS and HTTP Upgrade
preserve internal principal and full path
The public and internal opening handshakes return two independent 101 responses.
Each hop has its own connection_id, RequestFrame.id, EventFrame.seq,
Ping/Pong, backpressure budget, and close lifecycle.
The public Frame never exposes session_id or the internal connection identity.
The internal Frame never carries chat_id or final-user identity.
mate-service terminates both protocols and performs semantic projection.
Private keys and inbound credentials never enter Frames, Prompt, or Manager calls.
URL v1 and Frame protocol 2 are independent versions.
Public success is emitted only after internal create or resume succeeds.
